2 شذّب , inf. n. تَشْذِيبُ: see above, in four places. ―
-b2- [Hence,] تَشْذِيبٌ signifies also The shaping an arrow by the first operation: (AHn, K:) the second operation is termed تَهْذِيبٌ. (AHn.) ―
-b3- And شذّبهُ, (Sh, TA,) inf. n. as above, (Sh, K,) He drove away him, or it, (Sh, K, * TA,) from a thing; (TA;) as also ↓ شَذَبَهُ , aor.
شَذِبَ , inf. n. شَذْبٌ: (Sh, TA:) and عَنْهُ ↓ شَذَبَ he repelled from him, or defended him. (S, K.) ―
-b4- And شَذَّبْتُ المَالَ, (Kt, TA,) inf. n. as above, (K,) (assumed tropical:) I dispersed, or scattered, the property. (Kt, K, * TA.) ―
-b5- [And accord. to Golius, on the authority of a gloss in a copy of the KL, شذّب also signifies He made long.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
